purpose: Consolidate which registry is authoritative for each part of Potato House navigation so planes, Trees, Rooms, seeds, spirals, entities and pages can grow without duplicating or contradicting one another.

authorities.rule: Before redefining high-frequency operators such as Plane, Axis, Door, Cross, Spiral, Tree, Root, Seed, Garden, Source Field or Manifestation Field, route through this registry to the canonical definition/contract owner and keep specialist files narrow.

authorities.concern: operator family classification / Door Cross Spiral Tree Swamp
authorities.rule: Classifies high-frequency operator files into definition/contract, specialist, research, archaeology, benchmark and reader/story roles. A filename containing an operator never grants canonical ownership.

authorities.concern: bidirectional O-centered spiral field / ring layers / Mountain Swamp overlays
authorities.rule: Owns the shared double-spiral geometry, layer/ring family, chirality and terrain-overlay boundaries. Exact logarithmic geometry, shifted O-origin project geometry and Vesica geometry must remain distinguished.
Owns the full transition lifecycle from prior state through rim/guard, crossing, Here/Now, incorporation, Plane snapshot, recurrence classification, Fruit, Seed and return.

authorities.concern: Tree family typing / generic Life Knowledge Strife world-tree archive and UI trees
authorities.rule: Owns Tree-family type distinctions and naming rules. Generic Tree branching, tradition-specific Trees, project Strife, archive trees and UI trees must remain explicitly typed.

authorities.concern: Root Seed temporal and provenance/future-capacity semantics
authorities.rule: Separates Root as surviving provenance/support from Seed as present conditional future capacity across botanical, archival, theological and systems uses.
Owns generic Swamp entry, persistence, state variables, exit and recovery semantics. Subjects participate in relations/regimes; they are not intrinsically 'Swamp'.
Defines the Potato of Life as semantic center, distinguishes it from Axis as spatial center, and governs center-out importance rings and promotion.

authorities.concern: three typed centers / figure and archetype population
authorities.rule: Owns project-persona, Christian, Jewish and comparative figure/archetype population around C_F, O and C_S. Center placement is a typed role correspondence, never a literal-identity claim, target map or replacement for tradition-owned meaning.

authorities.concern: three-center relational roles / Dog Footstool Cow Farmer perimeter ecology
authorities.rule: Owns contextual roles around C_F, O and C_S—guard, support, harvest, witness, constraint, local centers and role transitions—while the three-center role atlas owns figure/archetype population. Role labels are contextual and reversible, never fixed human essences.

authorities.concern: central relational ontology / Father Mind Root, Son Body Lion, Door Here Now, Spirit Ladder Time
authorities.rule: Owns the stable relation grammar among center roles and operators while specialist files retain provenance, tradition, body, science and timeline detail. Relations are functional and typed; resemblance is never silent identity.
Owns the project synthesis Father/Mind, Son/Body, Jesus/Door/Here, Spirit/Ladder/Time and Spiral/history while specialist theology/body/science files retain evidence and external context.

authorities.concern: circle field research / center interior rim overlap trajectory grammar
authorities.rule: Provides research-grounded placement guidance for the two-circle projection. Core topology owns the durable geometry; this synthesis owns comparative rationale, external analogies and research boundaries.

authorities.concern: Plane research and real-world section analogies
authorities.rule: Owns comparative rationale from geometry, anatomy, dynamical systems and spacetime slicing. Core topology owns the durable project semantics.
Canonically distinguishes Plane, Axis, O/Cross-point, Cross-sign, Door and crossing events; every Plane is frame-relative and not a realm.
Provides a non-owning Hawkins-adjacent qualitative state lens. No numerical vibration/consciousness measurement, human ranking or truth inference is permitted.
Pairs upper and lower functions by relation and bridge rather than moral caste; preserves healthy descent, rooting and return.
Populates the Heaven/source-facing projection with Genesis/Garden/House/Light/Messenger/Axis/virtue/return systems without upgrading truth rank or collapsing traditions.
Binds development waves, core operator pairings, Room contributions, living systems, tests and public composition without replacing canonical owners.

authorities.concern: deep element definitions and cross-system structural distinctions
authorities.rule: Defines what major operators are, how they transform, what they couple to, and what they must not be collapsed into; specialist historical atlases remain source owners for tradition-specific detail.
Standardizes local centers for Dwellings, Rooms, surfaces and artifacts while preserving Potato as semantic center and Axis as global spatial center.
Defines how mature Works declare source Rooms, Fruit types, intended effects, reception, risks and future Seed without equating completion/popularity with success.
Governs additive, narrowing, strengthening, reinterpretive, corrective, superseding and retraction revisions while preserving prior states/provenance.
Defines non-owning lenses that reinterpret center-native material without creating Rooms, planes or realms.
Coordinates organism, Spirit/relation, memory/history, Foundations/generative memory and culture/formation across existing Room owners without creating replacement ownership.
Defines the ten canonical knowledge-owning Dwellings.
Defines the 38 mature nested Rooms and their boundaries.
Assigns substantive repository knowledge to primary Rooms.
Defines high-level plane/compass projection, not detailed route mechanics.
Defines operators such as Door, Axis, Root, Tree, Spiral, Fruit, Garden and Swamp and their typed relations.
Projects governed Rooms and sparse landmarks into navigation slices.
Decides how Life, Strife, Repair, Roots, trunk and canopy cross Heaven/World/Below.
Decides C_S Seed Junction, Seed of Death/Life, Rooting, Drain, Sprouting, Repair, Return and Ring.
Defines transition states, flow behavior and finer vertical projection.
Curates named subjects with own-tradition anchors, Room placement, plane projections, Tree affinities and repository sources.
Defines sourced structural correspondences and anti-conspiracy boundaries for Providence, Great Seal pyramid, Jachin/Boaz and 1776.
Classifies whether a symbol is plane, terrain, regime, organism, material state, threshold, perceptual layer, process, route or inhabitant before spatial/moral interpretation.
Operationally resolves category, Room, plane, Tree/route affinity, corridors, boundaries and visibility for new subjects before they are promoted into curated atlases.
Explains the whole architecture but should reference—not silently override—the machine-readable owners above.

authorities.concern: symbol-depth research pipeline and conversation archaeology
authorities.rule: Deepen recurring symbols through conversation recovery, repository ownership, external scholarship, structural synthesis and bounded commits; preserve provenance and epistemic class at each handoff.

authorities.concern: deep symbol family retrieval for flow carrier measure celestial and tree systems
authorities.rule: Use conversation genealogy to recover project-native distinctions, then route each symbol family to its canonical historical/scientific owner before synthesis.

authorities.concern: symbol confusion resolution and population maturity
authorities.rule: Before adding a new symbol node or interface, determine whether the issue is synonym error, scale confusion, role confusion, projection overlap, productive tension, historical layer confusion or empirical-symbolic confusion; then route to the canonical owner.

authorities.concern: concrete society population and Spirit Mind Body projection
authorities.rule: Symbols are operators and coordinates; concrete people, institutions, organizations, cultures, infrastructures, records and relationships are the population. Spirit/Mind/Body are projections over records, not duplicate owners or ranks of truth.
Promote synthesis only when independently sourced bridge relations produce explanatory gain, provenance, testability and a new research or capability path.

authorities.concern: recent commit embodiment and depth completion
authorities.rule: Historical precursor for #257–#276. Current cross-commit convergence and completion state is owned by the materialization/crystallization ledger.

authorities.concern: concrete cross-domain revelations and evidence maturity
authorities.rule: Cross-domain syntheses must separate established mechanism, project mapping, and discovery candidate; every promoted revelation needs a concrete test and disconfirming route.

Every public entity case must preserve legal/institutional identity, source Spirit/Mind/Body facts, project-operator synthesis, known unknowns, tensions and falsifiable discovery questions; project operators never replace source identity.

authorities.concern: cross-domain foundations rules laws and refoundations
authorities.rule: Treat foundations as time-aware Seed+Center+Platform records with multiple clocks. Preserve substrate, adoption, legal effect, operation, consolidation, branching and refoundation separately; do not force ancient traditions or modern institutions into one birthday model.

A Foundation is mature only when its reproduction mechanism is identified: how later actors can reinstantiate the founded order through law, discipline, canon, pedagogy, science, protocol, ownership, manifesto or lineage.

authorities.concern: whole-project Foundation integration across schemas graph Rooms and Timeline
authorities.rule: Routes shared Foundation semantics into domain blueprints, graph references, Room lenses and public chronology without duplicating substantive domain ownership.

authorities.concern: Below intelligence shadow and clandestine-system research
authorities.rule: Below is a depth/intelligence platform spanning hidden provenance, lawful intelligence, shadow, illicit networks and Forge review. Preserve legal/evidentiary class and never infer guilt from secrecy, adjacency or symbolism.

Projects canonical intelligence/security, organized-crime, trafficking, extremist, high-control, digital-underground, illicit-market and casework records into the Below Platform without taking ownership from source domains.

Treat #257–#283 as one convergence sequence. A commit becomes durable only after its result is routed into canonical owners, concrete artifacts/population, interfaces, evidence boundaries, a reader/archive expression and validation or revision.

When a canonical element already has a strong definition, prefer concrete entities, dated observations, relationships, longitudinal measures, counterexamples and failure conditions over another symbolic definition or parallel atlas.
A route case must name starting state, operator, transition condition, supporting evidence, falsifier and World-level return measure. Route labels never replace subject identity.

authorities.concern: Foundation Seed Door genealogy time and place
authorities.rule: Foundation genealogy must separate prior/death-side state, Door crossing, life-side reproducible state, physical/institutional place, clocks, rise, fall/return and refoundation.

authorities.concern: Foundation stage placement across Rooms fields plane and Axis
authorities.rule: Place Foundation stages—not whole entities—by owner, field, plane, direction and route condition. Upper/lower is not moral rank.

authorities.concern: cross-domain Foundation landscape and trajectory comparison
authorities.rule: Use trajectory archetypes to navigate pressure, Door, reproduction, continuity and return across Foundations. Do not force distributed traditions into a single threshold or infer moral quality from vertical direction.
Reader-facing Foundation identity leads with Origin Door, physical/placeable origin, House owner/circle and dated Today snapshot; Seed genealogy remains subordinate technical detail.
Do not treat the Door as proof that a lineage lived. Record the earliest recovered post-Door continuation and label it as recovered evidence, not automatically the historical first.

Projects canonical Dwellings and plane landmarks into a reconfigurable 3D rotunda. Graph adjacency and local-center behavior are authoritative; visual Euclidean coordinates are replaceable presentation.

authorities.concern: reader journey memory through spatial House
authorities.rule: Defines private browser-local path memory, bead types, restoration behavior and journey visualization. Journey state is navigation only; it is not canon, analytics, evidence or user profiling.
Binds every active nested Room to one spatial interior route. These interiors are navigation projections only and do not alter bounded-context ownership.
Places cases, entities, concepts, artifacts and dossiers inside nested Rooms without promoting them into architectural owners. Repeated projection across Rooms does not duplicate factual ownership.
Centers cases, entities, concepts and artifacts inside a nested Room without promoting them into architecture or changing ownership; alternate Room lenses remain projections of the same object.
Records validated counts and referential-integrity state for Dwellings, nested Rooms, interiors, inhabitants, wormholes, journey memory and object focus as of the snapshot date.
Keep one object identity while projecting anatomy, project symbolism, historical tradition and systems lenses across Life & Body, House, Axis, Religion, Science, Spirit and Corporium.
Concrete concepts, cases and biological objects may inhabit several nested Rooms and switch lenses without becoming architecture or duplicate knowledge owners.
Natural-language discovery routes into canonical BODY owners; answers must preserve anatomy/history/symbolism boundaries.
A–Z and machine retrieval include questions, every core canonical record and governed Body objects; Explore record search consumes the generated cross-root registry.

resolver_order: 0. Ask how the subject relates to the Potato of Life project center; centrality is semantic/structural, not file-volume or novelty.
0.5. Use project-synthesis to pair the subject with its center contribution, Room owner, handoffs, tests and public route before adding another registry.
1. Identify the subject's canonical Room owner.
2. Identify own-tradition / historical source context before project comparison.
2.5. If the subject has a durable generative beginning, attach the shared Foundation contract: F0/multiple clocks, reproduction mechanism, branch/refoundation and preserved invariants.
3. Add plane projection: Heaven, World, Below or crosscutting.
4. Add Tree zone or route affinity: roots, trunk, Life, Strife, canopy, repair, return.
5. Add Seed/Spiral route only if the subject genuinely participates in burial, recurrence, rooting, ascent, drain, repair or return.
6. Add corridor relations to neighboring Rooms/subjects.
7. Choose visibility: landmark, room-detail or archive-only.
8. Pages render from these registries; page copy is explanatory, not a competing authority.

spatial_grammar.corridor: typed relation between Rooms or subjects
spatial_grammar.foundation: stable generative reference/platform created when Seed becomes repeatable through rules, practice, lineage, protocol or institution

anti_duplication_rules: Prefer extending a Room dossier or project-synthesis pairing over creating another master map.
Comparative and external subjects should point inward to project-native nodes rather than becoming parallel centers.
Do not create a new registry when an existing authority can be extended cleanly.
Do not copy detailed route sequences into topology.json when tree-plane-routing or seed-spiral-routing owns them.
Do not make named religious figures into new Rooms; they are subjects/inhabitants indexed into existing Rooms.
Do not assign moral essence from vertical placement.
Do not let public page layout become ontology.
A comparative resemblance never becomes historical identity or influence without source evidence.
Do not treat commit history as a canonical owner; materialize the result into domain/House owners and use the convergence ledger only to track that handoff.
